limitations.declaration: unlike ETH M0 (four per-seed anchors), USDCAD has ONE verified active anchor; the four screen seeds vary training/eval stochasticity only, so seed-level variation measures fine-tune stochasticity, NOT anchor diversity. The full_genome/usdcad_4h smoke champion produced zero trades and is REJECTED as an anchor.
limitations.system_differences_vs_eth: 48 features vs 83; window 1 vs 32; 1604 train rows vs 13699; entropy auto vs fixed 0.2 — M0-X measures transfer between two complete systems and can at best conclude 'not falsified in a second system', never 'universal mechanism'
